<subject>Team Meeting on May 9th</subject>
<body>
We will be having a team meeting on May 9th at 4 PM. We will be discussing credit risk modelling, upcoming regulatory changes, and departmental restructuring.  Pizza will be provided. I would like to have these meetings on a monthly basis to stay on top of the evolving financial landscape and to keep everyone updated with changes in Corporate Lending. If you cannot make the meeting or have something in particular you would like discussed, or have a preference in pizza, please let me know as soon as possible.

Thanks,
Brandon
</body>
